rules.defaults: These are the default rules. Change them here; you can return to the defaults at any time.
rules.tiersHint: Lines that create “entered the Top N” and “left the Top N” events. App pages always show time in the Top 5 and Top 10.

hint.bigMovePlaces: Places gained or lost in one reading to count as a big move.

hint.risingGainPercent: Share of the readings in that period that must be a gain.
hint.risingMinNetPlaces: Minimum places gained overall across those readings.
hint.newBestAfterDays: Days after a chart's first reading before “best rank ever” events start.
